source: in finite precision for some values. Tiling changes reduction order. Fusion can change when values are rounded. Accumulation precision can differ. ZXNAME0000XZ’s reproducibility documentation explicitly notes that ZXNAME0001XZ backends can produce different results because they perform floating-point accumulation in different orders.[13]
zh: 某些值的精度有限。平铺改变了缩减顺序。当值四舍五入时，融合可能会发生变化。累积精度可能有所不同。 ZXNAME0000XZ 的再现性文档明确指出，ZXNAME0001XZ 后端可以产生不同的结果，因为它们以不同的顺序执行浮点累加。 [13]
